title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Name & Address
description: Every package shall bear the name and complete physical address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer.

title: Generic or Common Name of Commodity
description: The common or generic name of the commodity contained in the package must be clearly specified on the principal display panel.

title: Net Quantity Declaration & Standard Metric Units
description: Net quantity shall be declared in standard international metric units (g, kg, ml, L, m, cm, or N) with correct spacing and no non-standard symbols like 'gms', 'kgs', or 'ml.'

clause_reference: Rule 6(1)(d) & Second Proviso, Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
title: Month and Year of Manufacture / Packing
description: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported shall be clearly indicated. A batch number alone does NOT satisfy this rule. Statutory exemption applies to incense sticks (agarbatti / dhoop) and bidis under Rule 6(1) second proviso (Clause g).

title: Country of Origin (For Imported Goods)
description: For imported commodities, the package must prominently mention the Country of Origin or manufacture.

title: Maximum Retail Price (MRP) & Tax Declaration
description: The retail sale price of the package shall clearly be declared as 'Maximum or Max. Retail Price ₹... inclusive of all taxes' or 'MRP ₹... incl. of all taxes'.

title: Consumer Care Redressal Mechanism
description: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number and email address of the designated officer or person who can be contacted in case of consumer complaints.

clause_reference: Rule 7 & Second Schedule, Legal Metrology Rules, 2011
title: Minimum Character Height (Font Size in mm)
description: The minimum height of numerals and letters in mandatory declarations must satisfy the Second Schedule based on net quantity (e.g. >=2mm up to 200g, >=4mm for 200g-1kg, >=6mm over 1kg).
